outcome: Neonatal encephalopathy leading to cerebral palsy
cohort: 70 NE-CP patients who had cephalic singleton pregnancy with attempted vaginal delivery at gestational week >=36; intrapartum occurrence of non-reassuring fetal status without apparent cause following reassuring fetal status on admission; and development of NE-CP, compared with 210 AVD controls who had 1- and 5-min Apgar score >=8.
finding: Suboptimal intrapartum care, cesarean section, successful trial of instrumental delivery, and hypertension were independent risk factors for NE-CP.
